info.name: Tidy Bity Backend API
info.description: Postman documentation for the Tidy Bity backend. Routes were generated from src/app/module/** route, controller, service, and model files. Set baseUrl and apiPrefix in the environment before running requests.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Account registration, activation, login, password reset, and password change. Most endpoints are public; change password requires a bearer token.

request.description: Creates a USER or EMPLOYEE auth account and sends an activation code. Roles accepted by the current model are USER and EMPLOYEE.
Sends a fresh account activation code to the user email.
Activates an account with the emailed activation code and returns access and refresh tokens.
Authenticates an active user and returns access and refresh tokens. Optional role helps detect wrong-role login attempts.
Verifies a Google or Apple Firebase ID token and returns token, role, isSubscribed, and productId.
Sends a password reset verification code.
Verifies the password reset code before reset.
Sets a new password after OTP verification.
Changes the password for the authenticated USER, EMPLOYEE, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN.

item.name: User
item.description: Authenticated user profile, employee management, and subscription status endpoints.

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile.
Updates the authenticated profile. Supports optional profile_image upload.
Deletes the account after verifying email and password.
Creates an employee under the authenticated USER account. Requires multipart form data with profile_image.
Updates employee profile fields. Email and password cannot be changed here.
Deletes an employee owned by the authenticated USER.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists employees for the authenticated USER. Supports QueryBuilder pagination, sort, fields, filters, and searchTerm.
Returns one employee by userId.
Returns basic subscription and trial status for the authenticated USER.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin profile endpoints. Use adminToken for these requests.

request.description: Returns the authenticated admin profile.
Updates admin profile details. Supports optional profile_image upload.
Deletes an admin account after email/password verification.

item.name: Rooms And Houses
item.description: House and room metadata endpoints for authenticated USER accounts.

request.description: Creates a house for the authenticated USER.
Fetches a house by houseId.
Lists houses for the authenticated USER.
Creates a room. If houseId does not match a house, houseName is required and a house is created.
Lists rooms for the authenticated USER. Optional houseId filters by house.
Fetches a room by roomId.
Updates room data. Supports optional roomImage upload.
Deletes a room by roomId.

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Task assignment, status updates, grocery workflow, notifications, and presets.

request.description: Creates one task per roomId for an employee. Recurrence values vary in the conflicted code; ONE_TIME and RECURRENT are documented from the latest branch.

body.raw:
{
  "assignedTo": "{{employeeUserId}}",
  "roomIds": [
    "{{roomId}}"
  ],
  "taskName": "Clean kitchen",
  "recurrence": "ONE_TIME",
  "startDateStr": "10/08/2026",
  "startTimeStr": "09:00 AM",
  "endDateStr": "10/08/2026",
  "endTimeStr": "10:00 AM",
  "taskDetails": "Wipe counters and mop floor",
  "additionalMessage": "Use eco cleaner"
}

request.description: Fetches a task by taskId.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists tasks owned by the authenticated USER. Supports filters like status and recurrence plus QueryBuilder params.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists future tasks assigned to the authenticated employee.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists today's tasks assigned to the authenticated employee. This endpoint appears in one side of an unresolved merge conflict.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists all tasks. Route auth differs across conflict branches; usually USER or employee-level auth.
Updates mutable task fields. Schedule fields are rejected by the service.
Updates status on either a task or a grocery item. Provide taskId or groceryId, not both.
Adds or updates a note on either a task or grocery item. Provide taskId or groceryId.
Deletes a task by taskId.
Creates grocery categories. Service expects an array payload spread into insert/create.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists grocery categories with QueryBuilder params.
Creates a grocery assignment for an employee. Conflicted code shows groceryList in the latest branch and groceryName in another branch.
Fetches a grocery item by groceryId.

query.description: Search term for supported list endpoints.

request.description: Lists grocery items for the authenticated USER or EMPLOYEE.
Lists notifications for the authenticated user.
Returns household task presets from household_tasks.json. This endpoint appears in one side of an unresolved merge conflict.
Updates mutable grocery fields. Schedule fields are rejected.
Deletes a grocery item by groceryId.
Searches grocery reference data by q.

request.description: Creates a budget. budgetImage is a string URL/path in the current service.

Returns built-in wallet budget categories.
